vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: At tag 1.10.4, HTTP/1 absoluteURI parsing and HTTP/2 :scheme parsing place the client-declared scheme in request_target; Pipeline.determine_scheme/2 returns that value whenever present, so a plaintext client can produce conn.scheme=https. Fix 45feea20 derives scheme only from the transport boolean.

atomic_bic.evidence: The PR #160 member is the smallest public commit that deletes the mismatch error and first writes {scheme, _} -> {:ok, scheme}; bounded all-ref -S history shows the mainline first-write only at its squash carrier ff2f829326cd5dcf7335939aef9775269d881e28, while later commits merely reshape the same behavior.

immediate_parent_absence.evidence: The immediate parent accepts only https/secure and http/plaintext pairs and otherwise returns request target scheme does not agree with transport; the vulnerable trust of a mismatched client scheme is absent.

squash_member_decomposition.evidence: GitHub PR #160 records exactly one member, 221dcba085289ee85adabac0bbcd9fce614c2247, merged as ff2f829326cd5dcf7335939aef9775269d881e28. Local objects prove both commits have parent 9b71290c3c225e88d536c4338a04578ed30d10ab and tree 599724645467a0cf1b29107baff4b71e84349e1a, so ff2f829 is the squash carrier rather than the atomic BIC.

affected_fixed_release_membership.evidence: Carrier ff2f829 is absent from 1.0.0-pre.5 and present in 1.0.0-pre.6, 1.0.0, and 1.10.4. Fix 45feea20 is absent from 1.10.4 and present in 1.11.0. This matches the authoritative ranges >=1.0.0,<1.11.0 and git ff2f829..<45feea20.

direct_fix_or_unpatched.evidence: The single-parent patch changes determine_scheme(secure?, request_target) to determine_scheme(secure?) with fixed http/https transport mappings and updates HTTP/1 and HTTP/2 mismatch tests to expect transport scheme; its parent still contains {_, scheme} -> scheme.

bic_only_ai_attribution.evidence: Attribution is based only on BIC 221dcba085289ee85adabac0bbcd9fce614c2247: author and committer are Mat Trudel <mat@geeky.net>, and the complete commit message has no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, Made-with, Copilot, Cursor, bot, or other AI marker. The GitHub committer on squash carrier ff2f829 and the later fix are not used for attribution.

findings: The primary record identifies the correct two-input source-to-sink mechanism and direct remediation.
The atomic BIC is the sole PR member 221dcba, not squash carrier ff2f829; parent absence and identical-tree squash topology are independently verified.
The published advisory, affected/fixed releases, direct fix, and human BIC attribution support NOT_AI with no unresolved gate.
